newsitem.title: USA: Sepracor submits FDA new drug application.
newsitem.headline: Sepracor submits FDA new drug application.

text.p: Sepracor Inc said Tuesday it has submitted a new drug application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for levalbuterol HCl inhalation solution.
Levalbuterol is the single-isomer version of the world's racemic albuterol, sold as Ventolin and Proventil as an asthma therapy with combined sales exceeding $1.5 billion.
The company said asthma currently afflicts about 15 million people in the U.S.
The clinical portion of the new drug application is based on nine studies in 42 healthy volunteers and 502 patients with asthma.
In the 362-patient four-week pivotal study, levalbuterol was shown to have a greater improvement in lung function than racemic albuterol after the first dose.
The company submitted the new drug applicaiton for levalbuterol about two years after acceptance of an investigational new drug application.
